desc:
🎯 Welcome to Snipe for Monsters!

How to Play:

🔫 Snipe monsters as far down the lane as you can

🐉 Catch and collect monsters from 26 different zones

💰 Earn cash from the monsters in your yard

✨ Buy better snipers for more luck and rarer catches

💪 Train on your Recoil Rig to gain Snipe Power

🌍 Reach new zones with stronger and rarer monsters

🌈 Hunt for Gold, Diamond, Ruby and Rainbow mutations

📖 Complete the Index to claim zone rewards
